_about: Reviewed links between VICOBA savings groups and their introducers (scripts/master/link_vicoba_introducers.py; docs/methodology/contact-research.md, 'VICOBA savings groups'). Only entries with status 'accepted', a reviewer role (reviewed_by) and a review date (reviewed_on) are used; an intake's introducer_ref, sponsor_ref or employer_ref is a proposal until it is accepted here. 'link_vicoba_introducers.py --propose' drafts entries in runtime/master/vicoba-introducer-proposals.json for review. A CDO link is a reference to the government run (gov:<run-id>:<ward or council office organisation_id>), never a copy. An officer route holds a role phone that a public body or the group publishes for the role (phone_basis 'published_for_role'), never a name; a number given with consent is never written here.

links.id: VL- plus 10 hex characters (link_vicoba_introducers.link_id: group, kind, reference)
links.group: the group's vicoba_group_key (preferred) or master organisation_id
links.introducer_kind: cdo_ward | cdo_council | ngo_field_office | bank_branch | faith_office | employer | group_published
links.introducer_ref: gov:<run-id>:<office organisation_id> for a CDO; a master organisation_id otherwise; blank for group_published
links.introducer_name: as the master or the government run holds it
links.basis: where the link came from (intake introducer_ref, introducer intake <file> line <n>, council extract, the introducer said so)
links.source_url: the source that ties the group to the introducer
links.evidence_excerpt: 25 words or fewer; never a number or a member's details
links.officer_known_through_introducer: blank | YYYY-MM-DD: the introducer named an officer with the officer's agreement (no name is kept)
links.reviewed_by: a role, for example 'Marketing and Partnership Coordinator'
links.notes: free text; never a number or a name

officer_routes.id: VO- plus 10 hex characters (link_vicoba_introducers.route_id: group, role)
officer_routes.phone: the role phone as the source publishes it
officer_routes.source_url: the page or document that publishes the number for the role
officer_routes.confirmed_on: YYYY-MM-DD: when the route was last confirmed

introducer_decisions.candidate_id: the intake's candidate_id (VIC-INT-..), or organisation_id for a master record or a welfare:<run-id>:<organisation_id> reference
introducer_decisions.organisation_name: as the intake or the master names it
introducer_decisions.reason: what the check found; never a number
introducer_decisions.source_url: the page or listing the decision rests on (recorded as a source record)
introducer_decisions.latitude: the listing's pin, or blank (a pin outside the catchment is kept: distance never removes a lead)
introducer_decisions.geocode_precision: point for a listing pin, or blank
introducer_decisions.risky: blank, or why the source is risky (for example a robots-disallowed site read with a browser)
